title: PAH-OMC-014 finite weighted tail bound for the future full-Q Cauchy split
question: What exact finite inequality controls the omitted full-Q tail once a source-owned normalized law supplies a tail-mass bound and a common cylinder envelope?
finding: Lean R506 proves that for a finite tail set s, nonnegative weights w, a nonnegative envelope c with |a_i|<=c, and a supplied tail-mass bound sum_i w_i<=tau, the exact weighted tail satisfies |sum_i w_i*a_i|<=c*tau. The zero-component corollary is also proved. Integrated, independent and hostile verifiers pass on distinct exact rational fixtures.
decision_reason: R503 controls finite-block weight and component drift but leaves the growing-Q tail as a separate term. R506 supplies that missing algebraic bridge without selecting sector weights, fitting tau, changing PAH-001, or treating C_sw=540 as a probability. It is reusable support only: the source owner still has to provide the law, the envelope, tail decay and the fixed-order topology.
boundary: Conditional finite tail inequality only. PAH-001 functional/rates, PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weighting, PAH-OMC-012 graded domain/projection and PAH-OMC-014 limit order remain unchanged. R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9 is retained; R-490 C_sw=540 remains domination-only. No source law, projective limit, Cauchy sequence, positivity/normalization, stationarity, semigroup, continuum or physical conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Obtain from the source owner one normalized cross-Q law with a finite-block/tail split, a common cylinder envelope c, and a source-owned tau->0 estimate in the fixed PAH-001 order; then combine R503 and R506 without fitting weights.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-014, the projective-kernel obligation, R503, R504, R505 and the route-local Q=0 obstruction.
Formalize the finite weighted-tail absolute-value inequality and its zero-tail corollary in Lean 4.32.1 using the exact Finset sum, nonnegative weights and envelope assumptions.
Register R506 with its exact source SHA-256 and run the pinned Lean toolchain check.
Replay integrated, independent and hostile verifiers using distinct Fraction fixtures, in-memory mutation tests and canonical source compilation.
Retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE because no source-owned cross-Q law, tail mass, common envelope, topology or ordered decay estimate is present.
assumptions: The future source-owned component block supplies a finite tail index set for each fixed comparison.
The future component cylinder values are real and uniformly bounded by a common nonnegative c on that tail.
The future sector weights are nonnegative and the source-owned tail mass is at most tau.
The fixed PAH-001 functional, Gibbs weighting, boundary convention and limit order remain unchanged.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized normalized cross-Q sector law or projective kernel.
Source-owned values or bounds for the tail mass tau and common envelope c, with tau tending to zero in the declared order.
A common cylinder topology and a Cauchy estimate combining the R503 finite-block term with this tail term.
A uniform-integrability/domain argument for positivity, normalization and stationarity after the functional is defined.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: R506 assumes a supplied tau bound and proves only c*tau; decay is a missing source-owner input.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: the manifest and hostile verifier retain C_sw=540 as domination-only.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: the defect is explicitly retained and no averaging or counterterm is introduced.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: source law, topology, block error, tail decay and stationarity domain remain open.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: all physical interpretations remain explicit non-claims.
